note: Panel recipe for tools/panelize.py. Tabs are given as a point near the board edge (single-board coordinates, mm, KiCad front view) and the outward direction; the tool finds the exact edge. The ground fill stops 0.55 mm short of the edge and no track runs near an edge, so tabs only have to stay clear of the notch for the Nunchuck plug (top edge, x 100.5-114.5), the Qwiic pads (both sides, y 117-125) and the SAO connector (bottom, x 100-115).

right edge, below the Qwiic pads
bottom edge, left of the connector
bottom edge, right of the connector
